hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && for step in "ruff check ." "python3 orchestrator/style_test.py" "cd orchestrator && python3 -m unittest flow_spec_test spec_sync_test"; do out=$(bash -c "$step" 2>&1) || { echo "FAILED: $step" >&2; echo "$out" | grep -v "^[[:space:]]*$" | tail -15 >&2; exit 2; }; done
